heading: Settings
subheading: Workspace defaults for meetings, minutes and translation. Access and data protection live in Security.

accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.description: Only workspace Owners and Administrators can view or modify workspace configurations.

loadError.title: Couldn't load workspace settings
loadError.description: The current configuration could not be read, so nothing is shown here rather than showing defaults that are not this workspace's. Retry, and if it keeps failing check that the workspace service is reachable.

workspaceInfo.heading: Workspace Info
workspaceInfo.slugDescription: The unique handle for identifying this workspace.
workspaceInfo.urlDescription: The direct landing link for members to access this workspace.

defaultLanguage.label: Default Language
defaultLanguage.description: Default spoken language for new translation rooms.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: Timezone used for meeting schedules and audit timestamps.

maxActiveRooms.label: Max Active Rooms
maxActiveRooms.description: Maximum concurrent translation rooms allowed for this workspace.

ceiling.plan: Your plan allows {ceiling} concurrent rooms, so {ceiling} is what applies. A higher number here has no effect — this setting can only lower the limit.
ceiling.platformDefault: Until this workspace has an active plan it is limited to {ceiling} concurrent rooms, so {ceiling} is what applies. A higher number here has no effect — this setting can only lower the limit.
ceiling.workspaceOverride: This workspace is limited to {ceiling} concurrent rooms, so {ceiling} is what applies. A higher number here has no effect — this setting can only lower the limit.

artifactRetentionDays.label: Artifact Retention Days
artifactRetentionDays.description: Days to retain meeting transcripts and recordings (0 = indefinite).

minutesClassification.label: Minutes Classification
minutesClassification.description: Default classification printed on new meeting minutes for this workspace.

minutesTemplate.label: Minutes Template
minutesTemplate.description: Layout this workspace's minutes open in and export as. Neither template replaces the other — both present the same record.

allowedTargetLanguages.label: Allowed Target Translation Languages
allowedTargetLanguages.description: Languages available for live translation in meeting rooms.

ceiling.plan: Your plan allows {ceiling} target languages per meeting. You may permit more here — a single meeting simply cannot use more than {ceiling} at once.
ceiling.platformDefault: Until this workspace has an active plan it is limited to {ceiling} target languages per meeting. You may permit more here — a single meeting simply cannot use more than {ceiling} at once.
ceiling.workspaceOverride: This workspace is limited to {ceiling} target languages per meeting. You may permit more here — a single meeting simply cannot use more than {ceiling} at once.

voiceCloning.label: Voice Cloning Synthesis
voiceCloning.description: Synthesize translated speech using neural voice cloning of original speakers.

profanityFilter.label: Profanity Filter
profanityFilter.description: Censor inappropriate or profane language in transcripts.

allowPersonalPlugins.label: Allow personal plugins
allowPersonalPlugins.description: Allow members to use their connected plugins in WarpBot conversations for this workspace.

useGlobalGlossary.label: Use global glossary
useGlobalGlossary.description: Merge the global glossary into new transcript and translation prompts.

validation.invitationExpiryMin: Expiry must be at least 1 day
